verdict.rationale: Better Stack only monitors external CRON jobs and serverless workers for failures (docs-6, docs-16) and manages recurring on-call schedules for incident escalation (docs-12, docs-24, docs-46) — none of this is a mechanism for an AI-native user to define or schedule their own recurring automated jobs/workflows within the platform. No evidence of a workflow/job scheduling engine, automation triggers, or recurring task creation exists in the pack.
